scope.targets: 90 M2-L cumulative models: 3 outcomes x 3 representative metrics (UTCI, IMS relative humidity, IMS rainy-day count) x 10 windows
scope.excluded: the 18 DLM cumulative-effect bootstrap rows of the 198-row frozen file (window_or_lag = 59, i.e. the archived L01-L59 horizon; participant 2000 and assessment-date 1000 resamples) and every final L01-L56 simultaneous band: outside this batch (declared NOT_TESTED in the reference bundle)

original_rules_preserved.rng: Mersenne-Twister, Inversion, Rejection (R 4.4.3 defaults; set.seed(seed) at the start of every target and scheme)
original_rules_preserved.seed: config seed 20260729 + target_index * 100 + (1 for the assessment-date scheme)
original_rules_preserved.target_index: increments by 1 for every (outcome, representative metric, window) in the order outcome, metric, window; and by one more after the ten windows of each outcome-metric block (the legacy DLM target), so the 90 cumulative targets use indices 1-10, 12-21, 23-32, 34-43, ...
original_rules_preserved.participant_sample: sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE) over all 55 rows, once per replicate in replicate order
original_rules_preserved.cluster_sample: groups <- unique(as.character(date label)) in order of first appearance; sampled <- sample(groups, length(groups), replace = TRUE); rows = concatenation, in sampled order, of the original row indices of each sampled date (every participant of each sampled occurrence is retained, repeated dates repeat their participants); the date label is assessment_day (one-to-one with the calendar date; the draw sequence depends only on first-appearance order)
original_rules_preserved.refit: M2-L covariates (Sex, Age, AssessmentDay_centered [not recomputed], Locality_3group, Econ_STS); complete cases of the resampled rows; levels absent from the resample dropped; fewer than length(covariates) + 4 complete cases gives a failed refit; OLS (lm) for the continuous outcomes, ML logistic (glm, binomial, default control epsilon 1e-8, maxit 25) for high integration; reported quantity = the RAW coefficient of the exposure (per exposure unit; log odds for the binary outcome; not per SD)
original_rules_preserved.failure_rules: a refit is successful iff its exposure coefficient is finite; errors, aliased exposure and non-finite values are failures; failed samples are NOT redrawn; glm non-convergence is recorded but the coefficient is kept (as in the original)
original_rules_preserved.summary: median of the successful estimates; 95% percentile interval = stats::quantile(successful, c(0.025, 0.975), type = 8) when at least 20 refits succeeded, otherwise missing; positive_fraction and negative_fraction among successful estimates; interval_excludes_null = both limits finite and (lower > 0 or upper < 0)

implementation.fit_engine: stats::lm.fit / stats::glm.fit on the design matrix built directly from the resampled rows (identical column space and order as the original formula interface), instead of lm()/glm() with model.frame; bitwise-identical estimates are expected and tested on identical resamples
implementation.parallelism: none (single process): deterministic by construction; worker-count equivalence therefore not applicable
implementation.resumption: target-level checkpoints (one file per outcome-metric-window-scheme) written atomically in the run folder; reused only if the signature (input hash, configuration hash, protocol hash, source fingerprint, replicates, seed) is unchanged

mathematical_verification.note: checks: sampling invariants on every replicate (participant: length n and valid indices; cluster: every sampled occurrence retains all its participants in sampled order) and selection uniformity; legacy-style refits (lm/glm with model.frame) on identical resamples; independent type-8 quantile and median; independent seed/target-index formula; recomputation of two targets; conservation of attempted = successful + failed; the full-sample fit equals the validated cumulative M2-L estimate

scientific_validity.note: Descriptive flags, reported separately from legacy agreement and never used to alter, redraw or replace any result.
